title: Tauri: grant per-file runtime fs scope when opening .fla outside scoped dirs
description: Task 1394 narrowed apps/desktop fs scope from whole-home to content dirs (document/download/desktop/picture/audio/video). Consequence: opening a .fla located outside those dirs now fails because the webview lacks read scope for arbitrary paths. Fix: when the user picks a file via the native open dialog, grant a per-file (or per-directory) runtime scope from the dialog result (Tauri fs scope allow at runtime / tauri-plugin-fs allow), so user-chosen files anywhere are readable without widening the static capability. Acceptance: opening a .fla from an arbitrary path works; static capability stays narrow; no regression to save/publish. File(s): apps/desktop (capabilities + the dialog/open flow, e.g. useFileActions). Reference: task 1394 (commit ca73508).
